subject: reasoning
question: PSKO is related to ILDH in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, RUMQ is related to KNFJ. To which of the given options is TWOS related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is that each letter of the first term is shifted backward by 7 positions to get the second term.

PSKO : ILDH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3b240fd8302905a496383d3400d1ec37163eb9c3d17095165aa5a6876321d54.png] 

RUMQ : KNFJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c868cfdb8e1b7373b63a22a6fb7c4ad773afd4fa8b47c286e294a24978d33f3c.png] 

**Applying the logic to TWOS:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/602b62352a873ee6dc207f774ae1945e82417c5839906238eaf8507403e5b5cc.png] 

Thus, TWOS is related to **MPHL**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3"**.
